tools.name: bukku_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, employees) with name, code, type, receivable and payable balances. Search matches the name, receivable, payable and created date. GET /contacts.

tools.name: bukku_get_contact
tools.description: One contact with its persons, addresses, tax and registration numbers, default accounts and credit limit. GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_contact_groups
tools.description: List the contact groups; use their ids to filter bukku_list_contacts. GET /contacts/groups.

tools.name: bukku_list_accounts
tools.description: List ledger accounts from the chart of accounts, optionally by category. Account ids are used on invoice lines. GET /accounts.

tools.name: bukku_get_account
tools.description: One ledger account by id. GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_products
tools.description: List products and bundles (sales and purchase details, SKU, stock). GET /products.

tools.name: bukku_get_product
tools.description: One product with its units, prices, accounts and tax settings. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_product_groups
tools.description: List the product groups. GET /products/groups.

tools.name: bukku_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with number, date, contact, amount, balance and payment status. Filter by date, customer, payment status (PAID, OUTSTANDING, OVERDUE) or keywords. GET /sales/invoices.

tools.name: bukku_list_sales_documents
tools.description: List quotes, sales orders, delivery orders, credit notes, customer payments or refunds (invoices have their own tool, bukku_list_sales_invoices). payment_status applies to credit notes, payments and refunds only. GET /sales/{quotes|orders|delivery_orders|credit_notes|payments|refunds}.

tools.name: bukku_get_sales_document
tools.description: One sales document in full (lines, taxes, terms, payments, status): an invoice, quote, order, delivery order, credit note, payment or refund. GET /sales/{type}/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_purchase_bills
tools.description: List purchase bills with number, date, supplier, amount, balance and payment status. Filter by date, supplier, payment status (PAID, OUTSTANDING, OVERDUE) or keywords. GET /purchases/bills.

tools.name: bukku_list_purchase_documents
tools.description: List purchase orders, goods received notes, supplier credit notes, supplier payments or refunds (bills have their own tool, bukku_list_purchase_bills). payment_status applies to credit notes, payments and refunds only. GET /purchases/{orders|goods_received_notes|credit_notes|payments|refunds}.

tools.name: bukku_get_purchase_document
tools.description: One purchase document in full (lines, taxes, terms, payments, status): a bill, order, goods received note, credit note, payment or refund. GET /purchases/{type}/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_journal_entries
tools.description: List manual journal entries by date, status or keywords. GET /journal_entries.

tools.name: bukku_get_journal_entry
tools.description: One journal entry with its debit and credit lines. GET /journal_entries/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List banking transactions: money in (incomes), money out (expenses) or transfers between accounts. contact_id and sort_by do not apply to transfers. GET /banking/{incomes|expenses|transfers}.

tools.name: bukku_get_bank_transaction
tools.description: One money in, money out or transfer transaction in full. GET /banking/{incomes|expenses|transfers}/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags (labels) that can be put on transactions. GET /tags.

tools.name: bukku_get_lookup_lists
tools.description: Reference data needed to fill in documents: tax codes, payment terms, payment methods, currencies, countries, accounts, contact groups, product groups, price levels, tag groups, number formats, custom fields and company settings. Read-only (POST /v2/lists is a read endpoint).

tools.name: bukku_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (customer, supplier and/or employee) in Bukku. The contact code must be unique (A-Z, 0-9, _ and -, max 15 characters). POST /contacts.

tools.name: bukku_set_contact_archived
tools.description: WRITE: archive (is_archived true) or restore (false) a contact. Archiving hides it from active lists; nothing is deleted. PATCH /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: bukku_create_sales_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales invoice for a customer. status defaults to draft (nothing posted to the ledger), status ready finalizes it and affects the books. payment_mode credit needs term_items, cash needs deposit_items. Companies with MyInvois submission switched on must pass myinvois_action when status

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bukku_get_lookup_lists · Private data: bukku_list_contacts, bukku_get_contact, bukku_list_contact_groups, bukku_list_sales_invoices, bukku_list_sales_documents, bukku_get_sales_document, bukku_list_purchase_documents, bukku_get_purchase_document, bukku_get_lookup_lists, bukku_create_contact, bukku_set_contact_archived, bukku_create_sales_invoice · Public sink: bukku_get_lookup_lists, bukku_create_contact, bukku_create_sales_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bukku_get_lookup_lists · Private data: bukku_list_contacts, bukku_get_contact, bukku_list_contact_groups, bukku_list_sales_invoices, bukku_list_sales_documents, bukku_get_sales_document, bukku_list_purchase_documents, bukku_get_purchase_document, bukku_get_lookup_lists, bukku_create_contact, bukku_set_contact_archived, bukku_create_sales_invoice · Public sink: bukku_get_lookup_lists, bukku_create_contact, bukku_create_sales_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
